b: Adentra Inc. has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire AccessSMT Holdings Ltd., a leading Canadian distributor of commercial doors, frames, hardware, access control systems and specialty building products. The transaction is expected to close in December 2026, subject to regulatory approval.

Founded in 1928, AccessSMT provides complete door opening solutions for healthcare, education, institutional, commercial and infrastructure projects, supporting customers from design and specification through installation and ongoing service.
The company employs approximately 490 people across 15 locations in six Canadian provinces and Washington State. Its brands include CP Distributors and McGregor Door & Hardware.
Following the acquisition, AccessSMT will continue operating under its existing brands as ADENTRA’s Commercial Doors & Hardware business, led by CEO Mike Barnes and the current management team.

“AccessSMT combines a leading market position with strong customer relationships,” said Rob Brown, president and CEO of Adentra. “This acquisition significantly expands our presence in the Canadian commercial door market.”

“Joining Adentra provides the resources and scale to support our continued growth,” said Barnes. “Our customers, suppliers and employees will continue to benefit from the same people, locations and service they trust today.”
